genius.notes: SCOPE is described by Hamilton Lane as a tokenized private-credit fund with NAV-based subscriptions/redemptions and qualified-purchaser access. The feeder offering is separate from the underlying SCOPE offering and Securitize Capital manages the feeder. SEC EDGAR API fallback confirms the exact Delaware feeder name and Form D/D-A filing dates but did not expose the full exemption text; the particular Section 3(c)(7) subsection is therefore not independently reasserted. GENIUS payment-stablecoin authorization is not applicable to the reviewed fund interest. No regulator action-status inference is made solely from this exclusion.
